description: List audience comments (Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook Pages) and customer reviews (Google Business Profile, with 1 to 5 star ratings) in the Unified Inbox, plus open/replied/archived counts, average review rating and sync status (Studio and Pro). When sync.accountsSynced < sync.accountsEligible, call inbox_sync once to pull recent comments and reviews. Changes nothing.

accountId.description: Optional account id from accounts_list to view one connected account.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

kind.description: Filter by item type: "all" (default), "comment" (social comments), or "review" (Google Business Profile reviews).

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1 to 200; 50 when left out).

provider.description: Optional network key such as "bluesky", "instagram", "facebook" or "google".

name: inbox_list
title: List inbox comments and reviews
